# Dao Blackgold Video

Create the black-and-gold visual branch of the Dao series. Use `$dao-video` for shared project state, approval gates, MiniMax voice, subtitles, BGM, packaging, publishing preparation, and performance review. Use this skill for black-gold-specific copy presentation, Ark prompts, visual continuity, and covers.

## Workflow

1. Resume the project through `$dao-video`; do not create parallel manifests or duplicate shared scripts.
2. Confirm the topic and narration before paid generation.
3. Convert narration into one compact literary phrase plus one plain-language explanation per card.
4. Read [references/blackgold-style.md](references/blackgold-style.md) before writing prompts or covers.
5. Generate stills with the Ark scripts in `$dao-video`; present the stills before generating clips.
6. Preserve the recurring young Taoist's age, clothing, facial character, palette, lighting, and framing across scenes.
7. Remove generated clip audio, align captions to MiniMax timestamps, and apply the shared manual BGM envelope.
8. Build 3:4 and 4:3 covers from an approved unbranded frame; render final Chinese title and seal locally.
9. Return to `$dao-video` for validation, release packaging, publishing handoff, and performance review.

## Boundaries

- Do not mix the blue-white cover palette or ink-manuscript reflection system into black-gold video frames unless the user explicitly requests a cross-style experiment.
- Do not silently switch the configured cloned voice or paid model.
- Do not ask image models to render final Chinese text.
- Do not infer that a visually different competitor owns shared internet copy; check text lineage separately.
- Do not copy competitor shots or distinctive prompt sequences. Retain the format while creating new composition and symbolism.

## Completion

Complete the style stage only when:

- approved stills and generated clips remain visually consistent;
- foreground phrases and explanations are readable on a phone;
- the black-and-gold palette remains coherent across the whole cut;
- both cover ratios use the same approved source identity;
- `$dao-video` validation and packaging criteria pass.
